ideas.title: Summit Navigator
ideas.summary: A mobile-first, thumb-friendly conference schedule app for the inaugural ACM AI Leadership Summit (Atlanta, Aug 30 to Sep 2, 2026), with day tabs, track filters, search, a personal starred agenda, and a live now/next view.
ideas.description: Conference programs are usually published as long desktop-oriented pages that are painful to use in a hallway between sessions. Summit Navigator turns the detailed program of the ACM AI Leadership Summit (https://aisummit.acm.org/detailed-program) into a mobile-first schedule browser: sticky day tabs for the four summit days, sessions grouped by time block, color-coded track chips, full-text search across titles and speakers, and a star button that builds a personal agenda persisted in localStorage. A now/next banner uses the device clock and the conference timezone (America/New_York) to highlight what is currently on and what starts next, and every time can be flipped between conference time and the visitor's local timezone. The whole thing is a static client-side app: the schedule lives in one documented JSON file, so any conference can be dropped in by replacing the data file.
keyFeatures: Mobile-first layout with sticky day tabs and one-thumb navigation
Sessions grouped by time block with color-coded track chips and room labels
Starred sessions build a personal 'My agenda' view persisted in localStorage
Now/next banner driven by the conference timezone, with a conference-time/local-time toggle
Single documented schedule.json so the app is reusable for any conference
ideas.techStack: TypeScript + Vite, vanilla DOM, vitest; fully client-side, no backend and no paid APIs
ideas.whyInteresting: Every attendee has squinted at a desktop program table on a phone while walking to the next room. A schedule app that is actually pleasant on a 390px screen, works offline once loaded, and needs zero accounts is immediately useful, and separating the schedule data from the app makes it a reusable template for future conferences.
ideas.inspiredBy: Direct request: build a mobile-first, easy-to-navigate schedule app from the ACM AI Leadership Summit detailed program at https://aisummit.acm.org/detailed-program
